items.reason: The main face-on view in D-017 shows a rectangular plate dimensioned 180,00 horizontally and 110,0 vertically. The only outline departures are the small corner clips called out as 4x1,0 X 45°, and those are handled separately as corner_chamfer features.
The horizontal overall dimension under the main view is printed as 180,00 with deviations -0,01/-0,06. The deviations are tolerances, so the nominal X length is 180 mm.
On the right side of the main view, a vertical overall dimension of 110,0 runs from the plate's bottom edge to its top edge. That gives a Y width of 110 mm.
The outline is a rectangle, so outer diameter does not apply. Under the template rules, an irrelevant dimension is correctly left unknown/null.
The body is not a ring. The ⌀42,00 opening is off-centre (28,2 / 4,1 from the centrelines), so it belongs in features as a hole, not as an outline inner diameter. Unknown/null is correct.
In the upper edge-on view, the 10,0 dimension is linked by extension lines to the plate's two faces. Only one thickness is printed and no step is shown, so a single known value of 10 mm is correct.

That centreline is at the plate's mid-height, because 50,9 + 4,1 = 55 = 110,0/2, so y = 0-4,1 = -4.1 is supported. The 28,2 dimension runs from the full-height vertical dash-dot centreline to the bore axis, toward +X. That line is the matching orthogonal plate centreline in the same dimensioning scheme, so x = 28.2. The isometric view shows the bore going all the way through. Treating it as plain through is correct; the concentric rim line is omitted separately. Corner clips: the 4x1,0 X 45° leader points to a plate corner, and the edge-on view shows a clip line near each end, so these are full-thickness outline clips. The 45° callout establishes equal 1,0 setbacks, and the 4x count matches the four corners. No hole with an incomplete position was emitted.
The main view also shows 4 countersunk ⌀5,5 holes, 8 M5 holes and 2 ⌀6,0 H7 holes. None of their X/Y positions are dimensioned, so the feature set is not complete and false is correct.

All of them are listed. Each omission reason is correct: the hole centres or pitches are not dimensioned, the M5 holes have no drill size or depth, and the edge details have no numbers. The citations are original source IDs.

The holes left out only lack positions, which per the rules makes this an honest partial model rather than a blocked one. supported, constant_thickness and outline_exact are all correctly true, and the reason states the main view, the thickness source and that the model is partial.
